REQ-VALIDATOR, WF-03 step 02b round 2 for ISS-0002. Verdict: PASS.
REQ-002 criterion 11 (round-2 text) is testable, consistent with criteria 3, 4, 6, 7, 9 and with design v4, faithfully attributed, and lowers nothing. All four round-1 findings are resolved, the two new clauses are accepted, and I found no new defect. I did not edit docs/requirements.yaml. I extracted REQ-002 by its id from a snapshot taken 2026-10-01T01:58:22Z, whose sha256 4450091a...ba0b equals the analyst's AFTER r2 hash; the live file still had that hash at 02:06:42Z.

ROUND-1 FINDINGS

F1 (MEDIUM) - RESOLVED.
- The precondition now carves out the run-folder path and states its behavior: «у prepare-run по пути папки прогона нет никакой записи — любая запись там, даже битая ссылка, — это E_USAGE, код 2 (дизайн §4.1, P12)».
- The first kind is limited to apply-verdict: «цель apply-verdict — папка, ссылка или не обычный файл».
- P12's input now has one reading. The E_WRITE clause does not apply, and the carve-out itself demands E_USAGE with exit 2, which is what P12 asserts.
- The coverage list names this test («на битую ссылку по пути папки прогона prepare-run (E_USAGE, код 2)»). P12 is in prepare.write.test.js, which the check command runs.
- I re-traced the other prepare-run inputs from round 1. Each now has one answer, the same as in the design:
  - runs is a file → E_WRITE ENOTDIR (P03);
  - runs is a link → E_WRITE ELOOP (P04);
  - runs is read-only → E_WRITE (P05);
  - runs is a link to a folder that already holds <RUN-ID> → lstat sees an entry → E_USAGE, exit 2.
- Consistent with the design as it reads now. §4.1 (lines 114-122) says the same: any entry at that path, fifo and socket included, is E_USAGE, exit 2 (P12), and the rule «цель — не обычный файл» (§5.3 W1.2) is for apply-verdict targets only. The §6 E_USAGE row (line 746) agrees. Criterion 4 is byte-identical.

F2 (LOW) - RESOLVED.
- The coverage clause now asks for a test per variant possible for a command, and lists the variants: apply-verdict — target is a folder, a link or not a regular file, and a link on the path; prepare-run — a link and a file on the path.
- Reading recorded for RELEASE-VALIDATOR: this parenthetical is the closed list of variants, as proposed in round 1. Every other kind needs at least one test: read for comparison (W16, W17); read-only (W19-W21, W24-W29, P05); leftover (W14, W15, W38, P06); any OS error (W30-W46, W50, P07-P11).
- Under that reading the design covers every kind once the rows the CODE-DESIGNER is adding (W51/W52, P13) land.

F3 (LOW) - RESOLVED. The text now reads «повторный запуск с теми же аргументами (у prepare-run — с тем же --created-at) даёт те же байты целей, что запуск без сбоя». This matches prepare.js:28 (created_at comes from the clock unless --created-at is given) and the fixed --created-at the tests use (§9.5).

F4 (LOW) - RESOLVED. The post-apply cleanup exception now ends with «остальное как до запуска», as W46 expects.

THE TWO NEW CLAUSES

«(«папка вне runs/» из критерия 4 определяется по пути, без перехода по ссылкам)» - accepted; it is accurate.
- tools/src/cli.js resolveRunDir (lines 37-54) checks «directly inside runs/» on the path alone (path.resolve, path.relative). It then checks existence with existsSync/statSync, which follow links.
- The clause names only the «outside runs/» condition, so the existence check still follows links.
- So a link at runs/<RUN-ID> to a folder outside the project passes criterion 4 and lands in criterion 11 (W13, E_WRITE ELOOP).
- This is the reading the verified criterion-4 test already uses (cli.test.js:72-75 passes a folder outside runs/). Criterion 4's behavior does not change.

The P12 coverage item - accepted. It gives the new E_USAGE statement a named test that the same command runs. «каждый тест на отказ сравнивает строгий список до и после запуска» also covers it: §9.3 applies A5 to P12, with A1 = 2.

NEW DEFECTS - none. What I checked:
- The precondition reads as three conditions, then the failure.
- An EACCES on the lstat of the run-folder path is, by the cited §4.1, «записи нет». It then ends as E_WRITE «cannot be checked» under the OS-error kind, not as E_USAGE.
- On apply-verdict's path, a file instead of a folder cannot get past criterion 4 (resolveRunDir answers E_USAGE, exit 2), and the coverage list leaves it out.
- The E_USAGE case is not caught by «Тогда код выхода 1 ... только строки E_WRITE»: the precondition excludes it.
- Size: 2577 characters, still one cohesive deliverable.
- No wording lowers the bar; every change makes the text stricter or more exact.
- The YAML parses. Every REQ-002 field except status and criterion 11 equals round 1, and criteria 1-10 equal the pre-ISS-0002 original.
